components.note: Internal countability is formalised by L_in formulas (Ctbl, Inj, sigma_unc) and external countability as countability of ext_M(a) in the ambient theory (033 body 584-636). Cantor's diagonal argument is carried out inside an arbitrary model (annex 674-707), giving T |= sigma_unc and, with AC, T |- sigma_unc by completeness, with soundness returning it. Skolem-resolution proves: a countable model exists (conditional on T having a model); M |= not Ctbl(p) while ext_M(p) is countable; Inj(g,p,w) holds iff R_g restricted to P x W is an injection, so no element codes one; an ambient injection exists (choice-free recursion). The warning 703-727 explains why there is no contradiction and states conditionality and choice dependencies; remainder warning 71-92 summarises and points to these proofs.
